title: Anonymous Navy friend says The Abyss scene is close to the truth

tellings.quote: And he says maybe that scene where, you know, this sort of glowing object shows up isn't too far off from the truth.

plain: A friend of Jesse Michels in the Navy, whom he does not name, told him that a scene in The Abyss, a film by the director James Cameron set in the deep ocean, where a glowing object appears, "isn't too far off from the truth." Michels passes this on second-hand. If true, it would hint that something like that glowing thing has been seen in the deep sea.
